quest.title: Tatara Tales: Purification Device
quest.description: Xavier, who is researching the Mikage Furnace, seems to have had some new idea...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x25000

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you gathered all the necessary data?

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you! Wonderful. We haven't quite collected all the data we need yet. I believe it will take a little more time.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: That said, I've taken this opportunity to think about the structure of the emergency purifier...

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Just a last-minute trick I've pulled.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: According to our previous discussions, we must deal with a two-pronged problem: the Fatui and the Tatarigami within.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: I trust you will be able to deal with the Fatui. My part in this, therefore, is to deal with the Tatarigami energy.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: This emergency purifier is a device that I have had purpose-built for that task. However, I'm going to need your help to complete it.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: We will need some special materials to ensure this device functions smoothly within the Mikage Furnace.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Crystal Marrow, which contains an inert form of Tatarigami energy, is an ideal candidate for this task.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: In truth, the secret of the famed Jade Steel is that a special method is used to add this very material during the forging process to increase the strength of the metal.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Of course, the special method in question is a trade secret.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: If memory serves, this crystalline ore can be found nearby. Please help me obtain three chunks.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Well then, you have my thanks. Remember, it's 3 chunks of Crystal Marrow — bring them back once you've got them.

choices.text: And here I thought you'd have a more official name...

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Why, that is its official name — the "emergency purifier"!

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Unless... Are you speaking of its official product number, date of manufacture?

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Well, since this is a purely emergency device, we don't need such things.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: I suppose, although I would hesitate to provide this sort of aid during normal customer service...

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Have you got your hands on 3 Crystal Marrow chunks yet?

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Thank you, truly! These shall form the basic structure of our device.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Now, all we need to do is wait for our beacons to collect enough data.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Once we have that data on hand, I will make a few tweaks to this device accordingly.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Once all is ready, let us put a decisive end to this incident.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Do you have those 3 Crystal Marrow chunks for me?

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Hopefully this is as far as the situation escalates...
